AutoUpdate.Name: Update imported macros automatically
AutoUpdate.Hint: After a module update, macros you imported from Nik's Macros are updated to the new version, and the GMs get a whisper listing them. Macros you edited in this world are left alone.

Update.Title: Nik's Macros {version}
Update.Updated: These macros were updated to the new version:
Update.Edited: These macros were not updated because they were changed in this world. Import them again from the compendium to get the new version:
Update.Failed: Nik's Macros: updating the imported macros failed. See the console (F12).
